# Jumentix

> Jumentix is a software factory framework for building REST, realtime, and offline apps with shared contracts.

Site: https://jumentix-website.vercel.app
Docs index JSON: https://jumentix-website.vercel.app/docs-index.json

## Start here
- Getting started: https://jumentix-website.vercel.app/docs/jumentix/concepts/getting-started
- Concepts overview: https://jumentix-website.vercel.app/docs/jumentix/concepts/overview
- Architecture: https://jumentix-website.vercel.app/docs/jumentix/concepts/architecture

## Guides
- Create a REST API: https://jumentix-website.vercel.app/docs/jumentix/guides/rest-api
- Create a SPA or Offline PWA: https://jumentix-website.vercel.app/docs/jumentix/guides/spa-pwa
- Guides: https://jumentix-website.vercel.app/docs/jumentix/guides

- Create a Microservices SaaS: https://jumentix-website.vercel.app/docs/jumentix/guides/saas-microservices
